title: Fibonacci Number
problemStatement: Compute the N-th Fibonacci number (define F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2)).
intuition: Naive recursion recomputes the same subproblems exponentially → TLE. Memoization / iterative DP makes it O(n). Space can drop to O(1) with two rolling variables.

approaches.title: Brute: naive recursion
Better: top-down memoization
Optimal practical: iterative O(1) space
approaches.whyWorks: Each step uses the recurrence; induction from base cases.

specialTechnique.title: Space optimization (rolling variables)
specialTechnique.body: When dp[i] depends only on dp[i-1] and dp[i-2], store two scalars instead of an array — classic DP space trim.

edgeCases: large n (big ints / overflow in C++)
patternRecognition: Exponential recursion tree with repeated nodes → memoize
interviewInsight: This is the canonical “recursion → memo → iterative → space-opt” teaching problem. Walk that ladder out loud.
